nodes.label: Separate organizational contexts
nodes.description: Group related objects without conflating a shared content space and a conversation project.
nodes.acceptance: Test membership, access and movement independently.

nodes.label: Object collections and facets
nodes.description: Separate ownership, access, object type, origin and activity from hierarchy.
nodes.acceptance: Test shared-space indirect access, empty results, filters and permissions.

nodes.label: Composable page / block editor
nodes.description: Use searchable slash menu for content, references and interactive tools; create nested page or link existing page.
nodes.acceptance: Test keyboard, touch, focus, insert/reorder, deletion and reference identity.

nodes.label: Per-block table width and fit
nodes.description: Normal, Flexible, Full width and readability/equal columns. Do not infer exact sizes.
nodes.acceptance: Test narrow viewport, overflow, fit and screen reader headers.

nodes.label: Contextual AI and scoped edits
nodes.description: Side chat for broad work; selected text, inline mentions and comments for scoped work. Review proposals before acceptance.
nodes.acceptance: Test scope, undo/review, permission, cancellation, errors, keyboard.

nodes.label: Verified recurring updates
nodes.description: Distinguish a generated tracker from actual scheduled execution; verify saved task and run. Keep Updated unavailable at launch per guide.
nodes.acceptance: Test task enablement, next run, freshness, source and failure.

nodes.label: Intelligent UI / generated interface
nodes.description: Choose text, cards, forms, charts or interactive output based on need; state persistence varies by experience and chat.
nodes.acceptance: Test fallback text, state reload, control semantics, contrast and reduced motion.

nodes.label: Interactive visualization vs persistent app
nodes.description: Visualization is generally snapshot; sites are a distinct option. Show data context, labels, accessibility and simpler fallback on failure.
nodes.acceptance: Test keyboard, data table, units, blank/loading/error and export.

nodes.label: Unified content search
nodes.description: Search existing objects by type, with permission boundaries; Ctrl/Cmd+K. Not web search.
nodes.acceptance: Test keyboard, archived vs deleted/locked, access and filter reset.

nodes.label: Customizable mobile navigation
nodes.description: Home and Explore separate frequent work from discovery; pin/unpin/replace shortcuts.
nodes.acceptance: Test touch, focus, available destinations, full tab bar and responsive behavior.

nodes.label: Contextual collaboration
nodes.description: Shared page editing, comments anchored to content, review attribution and sharing controls when offered.
nodes.acceptance: Test permissions and simultaneous edits; do not infer implementation.

nodes.label: artifact lifecycle
nodes.description: Reusable artifact separate from conversation; create, edit, revisit, share; legacy artifacts before 2026-09-16 are distinct.
nodes.acceptance: Test reopening, editing, share permissions, plan restrictions.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: fine grained design
nodes.description: Direct text edits, element comments and generated adjustment controls for spacing/colors/layout; design system context; handoff bundle.
nodes.acceptance: Verify scope of edits, controls via keyboard, review and export.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: project context
nodes.description: Project-level knowledge and instructions organize related conversations; not equivalent to artifact.
nodes.acceptance: Test project boundaries and file access.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: installable artifact
nodes.description: Desktop installation gives app a separate entry point.
nodes.acceptance: Test installation availability, reopening, permissions, uninstall.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: interactive connectors
nodes.description: Connected service UI can appear inside chat; distinguish provider actions from generated app.
nodes.acceptance: Review tools and permission before actions.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: persistent agent
nodes.description: Agent has durable identity, job and working context; chat is one entry point.
nodes.acceptance: Test agent selection and context boundaries.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: avatar states
nodes.description: Idle, Thinking, Working, Waiting, Blocked, Done; motion communicates state, distinguish identity from progress.
nodes.acceptance: Provide readable text state and reduced motion; measure timing only from recordings.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: execution visibility
nodes.description: Show meaningful task execution rather than undifferentiated loading dots.
nodes.acceptance: Test blocked/approval/error and actual progress without fake percentages.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: pages
nodes.description: Pages reside in Bot Library; open via chat card; primary page beside smaller chat panel; controls and sharing; gradual rollout, Enterprise excluded per guide.
nodes.acceptance: Verify plan, permission, state persistence, loading and export.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: recurring
nodes.description: Routines run on schedule; can update pages; distinguish saved routine from generated tracker.
nodes.acceptance: Verify cadence, run status, review and failure.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: canvas edit
nodes.description: Chat beside editable canvas; Select & ask for scoped edits; previous/next versions; export.
nodes.acceptance: Test selection precision, version changes, autosave, keyboard and export.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: adaptive generative ui
nodes.description: Visual Layout and Dynamic View were introduced as generative-interface experiments; do not assume universal availability.
nodes.acceptance: Test semantic fallback and responsive layout.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: simulation
nodes.description: Interactive 3D models and charts for learning.
nodes.acceptance: Provide labels, units, keyboard controls and static fallback.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: document transform
nodes.description: Create quiz, infographic, web page, audio or slides from a document.
nodes.acceptance: Check source traceability and distinguish generated results from original content.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: study space
nodes.description: Study notebooks synchronize sources across Gemini and Gemini Notebook.
nodes.acceptance: Test source selection and cross-app identity.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: three region shell

nodes.acceptance: Test independent selection, focus and reflow.
nodes.evidence_status: documented product behavior / derived acceptance criteria

nodes.label: source grounding

nodes.label: study loop

nodes.label: mobile constraints

nodes.acceptance: Test platform-specific capability availability.

nodes.label: Dashboard refresh and connector access

nodes.evidence_status: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

nodes.evidence_status: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

nodes.label: Artifact sharing and storage lifecycle

nodes.acceptance: Test permission matrix, warning and irreversible removal.
nodes.evidence_status: corrected using official help articles 2026-11-26; runtime not tested

nodes.evidence_status: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

nodes.acceptance: Test setup, trigger, pause, failed run and approval boundary.
nodes.evidence_status: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

nodes.acceptance: Test private/shared data, reload, public-link warning and failure.
nodes.evidence_status: official search excerpt; acceptance criteria not executed

nodes.acceptance: Test exact anchor, unavailable source, keyboard and return.

nodes.label: Inline content and revision
nodes.description: Selection-based toolbar, block handle, inline generator and review
steps: Open a page and invoke slash menu
Choose Generate and describe content
Review draft in place
Accept, request revision, or undo
nodes.limitations: Documented text; exact error/focus/animation not observed

nodes.label: Interactive visualization inside a page
nodes.description: Generated visualization is a different output from a native page block; persistence must be checked separately
steps: Invoke Visualize with a request
Choose a starting point such as app, widget, screen or diagram
Review generated result and test controls
Request changes using adjacent chat
nodes.limitations: Official guide; not a native template inventory

nodes.label: Child page versus reference
nodes.description: Child containment differs from reference; drag handle can move an entire heading section
steps: Open parent page
Choose Page to create a child, or Link to page to reference an existing page
Name new child or select target
Navigate the related content
nodes.limitations: Official guide; exact navigation history and deletion restoration untested

nodes.label: Collaborative whiteboard workflow
nodes.description: Whiteboard beta; external invite policy; connected-app context not used on board per guide
steps: Request a board or choose the Whiteboards tile
Arrange shapes, arrows and sections with collaborators
Optionally follow a teammate
Transform to a document/deck or export PNG
nodes.limitations: Official help; association with generic canvas is contextual, not same editor

nodes.label: Collaborative spreadsheet workflow
nodes.description: Tabs, formulas, conditional formatting, dropdowns, checkboxes and charts; no connected-app live data at launch
steps: Start blank or describe a sheet
Edit cells with Claude and collaborators
Inspect outlined changed cells and formulas
Use version history or export XLSX
nodes.limitations: Official help; visual selection and history behavior not tested

nodes.label: Page creation, reading and update
nodes.description: Desktop page dominates window; mobile closes back to chat. Reader filters/switches alter view only and do not save
steps: Ask Bot to create page
Open title card in chat
Use adjacent page-specific chat to request revision
Earlier card indicates updated version; reopen latest

nodes.label: Library discovery and pinning
nodes.description: Library excludes user uploads and Cloud Agent returned files per guide; desktop shortcut Cmd/Ctrl+K
steps: Open Bot profile/details and Library
Browse date groups (five items at first) or use search
Show more or open item
Use overflow to pin/unpin; page owner can share
nodes.limitations: Official help; actual visual grouping and pin order untested

nodes.label: Page sharing and access failure
nodes.description: Private by default; public link allows reading and controls, but only Bot edits content; unavailable options explain why
steps: Open page sharing settings
Choose permitted audience
Copy link or narrow access
If access update fails, retry
nodes.limitations: Official help; no live access matrix tested

nodes.label: Canvas application editing and debugging
nodes.description: Edits auto-save; version controls documented for docs; preview errors and logs available
steps: Open app in Canvas
Switch to Code to edit or request a change
Inspect preview console and recent changes
Use Select & ask for scoped revision

nodes.label: Canvas sharing and app information review
nodes.description: Anyone with public link may view/edit associated shared data; distinguish app data from document content
steps: Open Share & export
Choose Share
Review app information about shared data, AI features and session persistence
Copy public link if appropriate
nodes.limitations: Official help; live security behavior not tested

nodes.label: Flashcard generation and review loop
nodes.description: Progress resumes; shuffle, delete card, restart, fullscreen and CSV where allowed. Edit access required to generate/delete study aid
steps: Select sources and Studio Flashcards or customization pencil
Choose difficulty/prompt; generation runs in background
Study with Explain, previous/next, known/missed controls
Review results; retry same, all, or missed cards
nodes.limitations: Official help; correct/incorrect visual design and actual state persistence untested

nodes.label: Quiz generation and review loop
nodes.description: Fullscreen and previous/next; no claim of exact submit-button behavior or answer timing
steps: Choose Quiz in Studio, customize if needed
Wait while continuing other work
Answer and use Hint/Explain or navigate questions
Review or retake at end
nodes.limitations: Official help; feedback and score states need screenshots

nodes.label: Embedded file permission vs reference
nodes.description: Uploaded files inherit page access; a link to a separately stored file does not itself grant access. Copied summaries on the page become visible to page readers.
nodes.acceptance: Check view/edit roles, embedded files, external access and revoke behavior.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Personal vs shared artifact state
nodes.description: Artifacts can store private per-user data or common shared data. First shared-storage use shows a confirmation. New artifacts can store before publishing; legacy artifacts require publication.
nodes.acceptance: Test two accounts, save/reload and visibility; distinguish current and legacy artifacts.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Invitation expiry and revocation
nodes.description: Pending email invitations expire in 30 days; accepted invitations do not expire automatically. Removing a person revokes access immediately. Organization settings and plan affect invitations.
nodes.acceptance: Test pending, expired, accepted, revoked and disabled external sharing.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Artifact permission roles
nodes.description: Viewer reads artifact/comments; commenter adds comments and downloads offered files; editor can change content. External commenters and editors have limitations; editors cannot delete artifact.
nodes.acceptance: Test each role and artifact type, including disabled comments and connectors.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Library content facets and pinned items
nodes.description: Desktop Library filters All, Pages, Media, Links, Files, Apps and Pinned. Team Bot separates private-to-user and bot files; pin treatment differs.
nodes.acceptance: Test filter results, pin/unpin and private/team visibility.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Stable page address and rename
nodes.description: Rename commits with Enter or cancels with Escape; a public page address remains unchanged after renaming. Custom addresses are not supported per guide.
nodes.acceptance: Test cancel, rename, stable link and access revoke.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Sharing conflict and retry
nodes.description: Share menu explains unavailable audiences, failed access changes and concurrent access updates; failed saves offer Retry.
nodes.acceptance: Exercise conflict, failed request, retry and inaccessible audience; no silent success.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Copy shared Canvas content
nodes.description: A public shared Canvas result can be copied into a user's own editable Canvas; shared app data is a separate concept. Copy/edit shared content requires age 18+, and links open in web.
nodes.acceptance: Test new object identity, original unchanged, shared data boundary and mobile limitation.
nodes.evidence_status: official documented behavior; acceptance checks not executed

nodes.label: Shared site with private inputs
nodes.description: Every user of a shared site, including owner, sees only their own saved inputs. Site viewers require access to the full notebook; public sharing requires consumer owner/editor.

nodes.label: Editor region navigation
nodes.description: F6 and Shift+F6 move among top bar, canvas/slide and properties area; Tab and Escape handle the conversation/artifact boundary.
nodes.acceptance: Test forward/backward navigation, focus restoration and nested edit mode.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Hierarchical canvas focus
nodes.description: Enter/Return moves into selected artboards or nested groups; Tab navigates peers; Shift+Return moves up one level. Escape exits artboard then clears selection.
nodes.acceptance: Test parent/child navigation, keyboard text editing and visible selection.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Selection toolbar conditional visibility
nodes.description: A floating selection toolbar is available when properties panel is closed; F6 can reach it and arrows navigate its controls. Escape returns to the canvas preserving selection.
nodes.acceptance: Test selection, inspector open/closed, arrow navigation and restored focus.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Scope-specific editing channel
nodes.description: Comments target component changes; chat is used for broader structure; direct manipulation adjusts geometry and alignment.
nodes.acceptance: Compare selected element, comment and broader request; do not infer exact pixel behavior.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Documented keyboard limitations
nodes.description: Placing new design text, shapes, notes or artboards requires pointer input per guide. Noninteractive generated web artifacts may be skipped by Tab and may not scroll with arrows.
nodes.acceptance: Verify keyboard-only creation and scroll fallback; do not label entire editor accessible.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Code-based motion artifact
nodes.description: Motion animates existing content as code rather than generating realistic footage. Edit timing or content through chat or editor; export MP4.
nodes.acceptance: Verify local change scope, playback, export and timing; no runtime measurement.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Design-system artifact and handoff
nodes.description: Design systems are reusable artifacts sourced from design references or code; documented /design-sync workflow can connect real components to design and implementation.
nodes.acceptance: Verify source ownership, import, handoff and fidelity without assuming perfect parity.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Direct document editing in chat
nodes.description: Expand generated files to edit or select content for AI changes; PDF editing supported on web/mobile, other listed file formats web-only per announcement.
nodes.acceptance: Verify actual route and file type support; direct file editor is not necessarily Canvas.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Staged slide deletion and restore
nodes.description: In revision mode, slides marked for removal are dimmed with a trash icon and can be restored before generating the revised deck.
nodes.acceptance: Test mark, restore, apply and cancel; capture actual states.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Deck revision creates new output
nodes.description: Revisions generate a new slide deck and consume revision quota; thumbnails can be dragged to reorder in the revision preview.
nodes.acceptance: Check original unchanged, new identity, ordering, quota and recovery.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Outline approval boundary
nodes.description: Optional outline review allows feedback before final slide rendering; Proceed ends refinement of that outline. Generation is nonblocking.
nodes.acceptance: Verify review, proceed, feedback limits, failure and ready notification.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Producer-note approval and scheduling
nodes.description: Video generation can use optional producer-note review before rendering. Generate later schedules without producer notes; after Proceed that plan cannot be further refined.
nodes.acceptance: Test review vs schedule, render progress, error and cancellation if available.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Interactive versus document report
nodes.description: Studio Reports offers interactive Learning Overview and document report generation as distinct options.
nodes.acceptance: Test template discovery, generation and persistent output behavior.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Audio formats and background playback
nodes.description: Audio offers Deep Dive, Brief, Critique and Debate, plus language, length and focus options. Playback speed and background listening are documented.
nodes.acceptance: Test speed, background playback, loading saved audio and source grounding.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Infographic object actions
nodes.description: Generated infographics can be renamed, downloaded as PNG, shared or deleted from the artifact menu.
nodes.acceptance: Test menu visibility, download rights, sharing and deletion.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested

nodes.label: Administrator page-sharing policy
nodes.description: Team admins can configure team-wide, specific-teammate or disabled page sharing as feature rollout reaches their team.
nodes.acceptance: Test disabled audience messaging and admin scope; not a live permission test.
nodes.evidence_status: official documentation or announcement; runtime untested
